headline: A 2020 law lets a private foundation build a memorial on federal land honoring journalists who died in service to a free press, at no cost to taxpayers.
what_it_does: The law authorizes the Fallen Journalists Memorial Foundation to set up a commemorative work on federal land. The work honors journalists who gave their lives while serving a free press. Federal money cannot be used for any part of establishing the memorial. The foundation alone must collect donations and pay all costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not give a separate effective date, so the law took effect when it was enacted on December 23, 2020.
